protocol.routing: Exact expected module AND status, overall and supported-only; all errors remain in denominator.
protocol.requiredFields: Frozen per-case fields; null expected values count only if field exists and is null. Micro average. Health has no required record fields.
protocol.allFields: All specified field checks including title keyword predicates and optional fields. Finite numeric money values compare exactly as Decimal, accepting equivalent formatting only.
protocol.workflowEntry: All backend checks pass AND real Android recorded-response replay enters the correct review form/Health page; clarification outcomes separate. Not per-case database insertion or live mobile network testing.
protocol.latency: Single sequential pass with one excluded warmup, nearest-rank P50/P95; report all requests and model-called subset. No Gradle/emulator test work initiated during inference. Background OS/user work is uncontrolled.
protocol.authorship: Internally authored held-out set, not externally independent. 120 paired scenarios in English/Chinese, correlated samples, no significance claim. Exact prior-prompt deduplication only. Never tune this run after outcomes; future reuse is regression.
